topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Oh my gosh, you will not believe this! So, I was scrolling through my feed today, catching up on all the usual stuff, and I saw this post from Alex. You know, my online buddy? Anyway, turns out, they're attending this local meetup this weekend, and guess what? It's like, a twenty-minute walk from my place! Can you even imagine? We’ve been chatting for months, sharing all kinds of stuff, and neither of us ever clued in about actually living in the same city. I’m buzzing, thinking about finally meeting them in person. What do you think I should do? Maybe I’ll swing by the meetup just to say hi!
